biggest_catch: $0.20 per minute means a typical 1-5 minute test pays $0.20 to $1.00, and invites are erratic — most people earn pocket change, not a side income.
catches: Zero guaranteed tests — invites depend on your preferences, profile suitability, country, and time zone.
Screening and qualification: most invites ask you to fill out a brief screener to ensure you are the right fit.
Variable availability: tests arrive unpredictably; the official FAQ does not promise any volume.
Effective hourly pay is very low: $0.20/minute on tests is $12 per test-minute, but each test is only 1-5 minutes and tests are sparse.
No unpaid-entry-test-free path: screeners are unpaid, and there is no guarantee of qualifying.
PayPal is the only payout method; SMS account verification is required at signup.
Interviews ($0.75+/minute) require a camera and microphone and scheduled Zoom/Google Meet attendance, and are not guaranteed.
Accounts are credited only once the session concludes successfully / your response is reviewed.

steps: Sign up for the UserCrowd Research Panel at usercrowd.com and verify your account via SMS.
Set up a free PayPal account to receive payouts.
Wait for email/text invitations for tests or interviews that match your profile.
Fill out the brief screener on each invitation to confirm you are the right fit.
Complete the test (1-5 minutes, $0.20/min) or attend the interview via Zoom/Google Meet ($0.75+/min) with camera and microphone.
Your UserCrowd account is credited with the incentive once the session concludes successfully.
